[SWS_LinIf_00078]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Lin_01564
⌈When the LIN Interface has received the SF or the last CF of a TP message success-
fully, it shall request a schedule table change to the applicative schedule by calling the
function BswM_LinTp_RequestMode with the parameter LINTP_APPLICATIVE_-
SCHEDULE (see [SWS_LinIf_00646]).
After successful completion or failure (e.g.,
since some other schedule table change is currently going on) of the schedule table
switch, the LIN Interface shall notify the upper layer by calling the function PduR_-
LinTpRxIndication with the result E_OK.⌋
